about_the_game:
Echoes of Edda is a turn-based RPG, set in a fairy tale world, where words are magic spells. Traverse through the lively yet treacherous world and find your way back home with your new friend.

Gameplay

Borrowing some features of the German language, the main gameplay consist of playing through roguelike Chapters, in which the player will battle enemies using the correct types of spells in a turn-based fashion. The most prominent of these features is that all targets have weaknesses that are 1 of the 3 German articles 'der', 'die', 'das', and using attack spells with the corresponding articles will deal massive damage.

Many spells can aid you in progressing through the chapters, such as support spells and Pluralfication (AoE attack).

Chapters

In between battles, the player will have to strategize about which path to take on the Map, as to gather more powerful gems and not exhaust themselves. Each of the 12 chapters has its own challenges, story based on kingdoms, and completing chapter unlocks new spells, abilities and enemies.

Builds

Bringing the correct spells, relics and activating the right skill tree abilities might just get you through that troublesome boss fight.

Characters

Ling

The college student was drawn into a parallel world after reading a mysterious book bounded in red. In this foreign realm, full of mythical and dangerous creatures, the girl set out on a journey to find her way home.

Leise

A mysterious demi-dragon girl on a journey to fulfill her dear friend’s wish: to reunite with their long-lost sister. Along her travels, she lost one of her horns, a silent testament to the trials she endured.

Credits

Developed mainly by SpazierGang members 

Game Director: EmperDev

Programming: EmperDev & Gabriel 

Art Director & Animator: AnTuowo 

Storywriter: Gabriel 

Sound Designer: EmperDev 

Business & Logistics: Marc Noffke

Showreel Song: Realm Of Eternal Legends (Composed by Alexander Nakarada) 

Free icons and tracks used from , dova-s.jp and

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: x86_32 CPU with SSE2 support, x86_64 CPU with SSE4.2 support, ARMv8 CPU
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated graphics with full OpenGL 3.3 support or Direct3D 11 support (Windows)
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 150 MB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX 12
  • VR Support: None
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: x86_64 CPU with SSE4.2 support, with 4 physical cores or more, ARMv8 CPU
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Dedicated graphics with full OpenGL 4.6 support
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 150 MB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX 12
  • VR Support: None
